changed.title: Majority of 7 bits (at least 4 on) has an AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in at most two with at most 19 gates
changed.statement: PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize 7 (fun x : Fin 7 → Bool => decide (4 ≤ (List.ofFn x).count true)) 19
changed.unlocks: a lower rung of the ladder for majority of 7, below the checked 21
changed.context: Answer with a circuit, not an argument: a gate list (operation, wires read; wires 0..6 are the input bits, gate j writes wire 7+j, each gate reads only earlier wires) and the output wire. Judged by one kernel evaluation over all 128 inputs. Any search method is welcome; only the circuit is checked. The rung at 21 is checked; we do not hold that circuit. Our own best without NOT gates is 22 (computed). We do not know whether 19 exists. If your circuit uses a NOT gate, say so.

changed.title: Two binomial sums bound the binary rank of one-hot tables at fixed nonlinear depth in fan-in-two circuits
changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
  xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
      (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depth := fun (w : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  (C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate w 0)).getD C.output 0
∀ (n m : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (u : Fin n) (v : Fin m),
  let entry := fun (a : Fin n) (b : Fin m) => if G a b then (1 : ZMod 2) else 0
  let A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) (ZMod 2) := fun i j =>
    entry i j + entry i v + entry u j + entry u v
  let represents := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n + m) C ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C
  let budget := fun (t b : ℕ) =>
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, Nat.choose (2*t) (j+1)) +
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (b-1), Nat.choose (2*t) (j+1))
  ∀ (d : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
    represents C → depth (n+m) C ≤ d+1 →
    A.rank ≤ budget (C.gates.countP nonlinear) (2^d)
changed.unlocks: bounds the anchored matrix rank for every finite nonlinear depth and gate count
changed.context: Introduce one formal product bit per nonlinear gate. Each product operand is an affine raw tap plus earlier product bits. Substitution on the output cone gives a polynomial of degree at most 2^(d+1) in 2t taps, plus a raw affine term. Split each tap into its bank labels. Four-corner differences erase pure terms. With b=2^d every mixed monomial has row degree at most b or column degree at most b-1. Group by the chosen nonempty squarefree monomial on that bank, one rank-one matrix per group. Allow 3 to 6 hours.

changed.title: Mask weights bound the polar rank and affine correlation of combined one-round cyclic row and column outputs
changed.statement:
∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k), 11 ≤ k →
  let W := Fin k → ZMod 2
  let ix := fun pos : ℕ => (⟨pos % k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let rot := fun (s : ℕ) (w : W) (j : Fin k) => w (ix (j.val+k-s%k))
  let run := fun (d s f : ℕ) (w name c : W) =>
    let z := rot s w + name
    let y := fun mid : Fin k => z mid + z (ix (mid.val+d)) + z (ix (mid.val+k-d%k))
    fun siteOut : Fin k => y siteOut + (1+y (ix (siteOut.val+1))) * y (ix (siteOut.val+2)) + rot f w siteOut + c siteOut
  ∀ (u v cr cc a b : W),
    let F := fun raw : W => dotProduct a (run 1 1 0 raw u cr) + dotProduct b (run 2 3 4 raw v cc)
    let unit := fun (j i : Fin k) => (if i = j then 1 else 0 : ZMod 2)
    let P : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) (ZMod 2) := fun left right =>
      F (unit left + unit right) + F (unit left) + F (unit right) + F 0
    let wt := fun mask : W => (Finset.univ.filter (fun index => mask index ≠ 0)).card
    let r := P.rank
    (k-10)*wt b ≤ k*r ∧ (k-6)*wt a ≤ k*(r+2*wt b) ∧
    ∀ (s : ℕ) (hs : s ≤ k) (L : (Fin s → ZMod 2) →ₗ[ZMod 2] W), Function.Injective L →
      ∀ (base : W) (ell : (Fin s → ZMod 2) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) (c : ZMod 2),
        let bias := ∑ x : Fin s → ZMod 2,
          (if F (base + L x) + ell x + c = 0 then (1 : ℤ) else -1)
        bias^2 * (2 : ℤ)^(r-2*(k-s)) ≤ (2 : ℤ)^(2*s)
changed.unlocks: Bounds affine prediction of both tests together and detects when quadratic dependencies require restricting the key family.
changed.context: In the joint polar matrix the entry at raw sites i−4,i+1 equals column mask bit b_i. Every entry at cyclic distance above five vanishes. In a cyclic interval of k−10 anchors the marked entries form the diagonal of a triangular minor. Average over its translates. The row-only matrix has radius three and outer entries a_i, giving the k−6 bound. Each selected column contributes polar rank at most two. Restriction to codimension c loses at most 2c rank. Apply the quadratic Walsh radical formula on the flat.

changed.title: The 7 by 7 crown (u joined to v when u and v differ): some AND/OR circuit of fan-in at most two with at most 22 gates represents it
changed.statement: PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun u v : Fin 7 => decide (u ≠ v)) 22
changed.unlocks: the crown ladder: whether one crown beats our held circuit at n = 7
changed.context: Answer with a circuit: a gate list (AND or OR, at most two wires read; wires 0 to 6 left, 7 to 13 right, gate j writes wire 14+j, each gate reads only earlier wires) and the output wire, judged on all 49 inputs with one vertex on each side. We hold 23 gates: one OR of the two vertex wires per index, then two-of-7 on those ORs by a prefix chain, 4n - 5 (computed). The 5 by 5 crown is exactly 15 and the 6 by 6 needs at least 18, both checked. We do not know whether 22 exists.
changed.shard_spec:
0: at most 22 gates in all, with at most 3 AND gates.
1: at most 22 gates in all, with 4 to 6 AND gates.
2: at most 22 gates in all, with 7 to 10 AND gates.
3: at most 22 gates in all, with at least 11 AND gates.
changed.sketch: This step decides an exact value: at least 22 gates is a checked row, so a circuit of 22 pins the 7 by 7 crown at 22; none found leaves 23.
